_about: What is physically in the house right now, beyond the always-stocked pantry staples (references/pantry_staples.md). The planner uses these first ('shop the freezer before the store') and the grocery list never re-buys them. Update when something arrives or gets used up. Set qty to 0 (don't delete) when gone so history stays readable.

butcherbox.notes: Everything arrives frozen. Keep it frozen. Thaw in the fridge on the schedule in each week's prep.thaw phase, never on the counter. Vacuum-sealed packs thaw fastest in a cold-water bath (about 30 min per lb) if a thaw gets missed.

freezer.name: Grass-fed ground sirloin 90/10
freezer.thaw: 24 hr in fridge per 1 lb pack
good_for: smash burgers on the Loco flat-top

freezer.name: Grass-fed flat iron steaks
freezer.notes: Cook hot and fast to medium-rare, rest, and slice against the grain. A 6 oz steak is exactly one Cameron dinner portion with leftovers for lunch, or half an Austin portion.

freezer.name: Grain-finished ribeye
freezer.notes: Fattiest cut in the box. Best as a split 'treat' dinner (two portions sliced), not an everyday macro protein.

freezer.name: Grain-finished premium steak strips
freezer.notes: Pre-cut, so it's the fastest weeknight protein. Marinate straight from thawed.

freezer.name: Organic free-range chicken wings
freezer.notes: Low protein per calorie (lots of bone and skin). Use as a fun dinner paired with a big high-protein side, or as a game-day meal. Save the tips in a freezer bag for stock.

freezer.name: Crate-free Italian sausage links
freezer.thaw: 24 hr in fridge, or slice from frozen
freezer.notes: Higher fat, so treat it as a flavor base, not the main protein. 1 lb of sausage stretched with beans or greens feeds four portions. Pair with chicken or turkey to hit protein.
